UGTS mechanism domain: Numeric/encoding.
M001 Radix digit threshold. Domain Numeric/encoding. A digit-count transition occurs at b^k in radix b. GPU realization: Integer compare or findMSB. Status RETAIN; validation Exact.
M002 Positional power weighting. Domain Numeric/encoding. Value is Σ digit_k·b^k. GPU realization: Shift/add for base 2; multiply-add otherwise. Status RETAIN; validation Exact.
M003 Literal binary glyph parse. Domain Numeric/encoding. Parser mode is part of the schema; `100₂=4₁₀`. GPU realization: Small DFA or compile-time constant. Status RETAIN; validation Exact.
M004 Left-shift pulse placement. Domain Numeric/encoding. A pulse at bit position k has value 2^k. GPU realization: Native integer shift. Status RETAIN; validation Exact.

M005 Zero-based offset/ordinal distinction. Domain Numeric/encoding. Offset is zero-based; ordinal is offset+1. GPU realization: Unsigned index with explicit display conversion. Status RETAIN; validation Exact.

M006 Active-bit filtering. Domain Numeric/encoding. Extract set-bit positions or popcount; never change numeric identity silently. GPU realization: popcount/findLSB loop/subgroup ballot. Status RETAIN; validation Exact.

M007 Zero as inactive/silence metadata. Domain Numeric/encoding. A domain-specific interpretation attached to bit state, not arithmetic. GPU realization: Mask channel and metadata tag. Status TRANSLATE; validation Schema-dependent.
M008 Binary 19 decomposition. Domain Numeric/encoding. 19 = 16+2+1; Hamming weight 3. GPU realization: Constant/test vector. Status RETAIN; validation Exact.

M009 Phonetic-to-active-count map. Domain Numeric/encoding. Associate an external label count with popcount under a declared language/tokenizer. GPU realization: Metadata join, not arithmetic kernel. Status BOUNDED; validation Corpus-specific.
UGTS mechanism domain: Numeric/fractal.
M010 Pascal parity recurrence. Domain Numeric/fractal. Cell parity is C(n,k) mod 2. GPU realization: Bitwise Lucas-theorem test `(k & ~n)==0`. Status RETAIN; validation Exact.

M011 Sierpiński generation. Domain Numeric/fractal. Binary parity recurrence yields self-similar triangular occupancy. GPU realization: One thread per cell or bitplane. Status RETAIN; validation Exact.
M012 Combination count C(5,3). Domain Numeric/fractal. Combinatorial count is 10; it is separate from value 19. GPU realization: Integer combinatorics/test oracle. Status RETAIN; validation Exact.
M013 Power-of-two scale boundary. Domain Numeric/fractal. Dyadic levels define exact multiresolution boundaries. GPU realization: Bit shifts and mip-like level IDs. Status RETAIN; validation Exact.
UGTS mechanism domain: Glyph encoder.
M014 Standard percent semantics boundary. Domain Glyph encoder. Default mathematical parser returns 1.0. GPU realization: Separate parser mode and unit test. Status RETAIN; validation Exact.

M015 Percent loop decomposition. Domain Glyph encoder. Represent glyph as two loop primitives and one slash/stem primitive. GPU realization: Vector/SDF primitives. Status TRANSLATE; validation Constructive.

M016 Slash/phi removal operator. Domain Glyph encoder. Delete the slash primitive under an explicit glyph rewrite rule. GPU realization: Grammar production `Percent→Loop Gap Loop`. Status TRANSLATE; validation Rule-defined.

M017 Open-loop terminal suppression. Domain Glyph encoder. A source-specific encoder suppresses the final active bit when the terminal loop is open. GPU realization: Branch in glyph compiler. Status BOUNDED; validation Custom rule.
M018 100100 concatenation. Domain Glyph encoder. Concatenate two 3-bit pulse words to a 6-bit word. GPU realization: `(4u<<3)|4u = 36u`. Status RETAIN; validation Exact under custom schema.

M019 Two-pulse timeline. Domain Glyph encoder. Treat set-bit clusters as two events separated by an address interval. GPU realization: Event IDs and relative bit positions. Status TRANSLATE; validation Deterministic.
M020 Pulse superposition by OR. Domain Glyph encoder. Combine non-overlapping pulse masks with bitwise OR. GPU realization: Native OR. Status RETAIN; validation Exact.

M021 Explicit-width complement. Domain Numeric/encoding. Complement must specify width and mask; topology route is not unbounded `~x`. GPU realization: `(~x)&((1u<<w)-1)`. Status TRANSLATE; validation Exact when width declared.

M022 Fractional scale correction. Domain Numeric/encoding. Multiplication by 1.5 corresponds to a log2 displacement of log2(1.5), not an integer bit shift. GPU realization: Multiply/FMA or log2 coordinate offset. Status CORRECTED; validation Exact.

M023 Packed fixed-width record. Domain Numeric/encoding. State fields have declared widths, scales and schemas. GPU realization: std430 structs, bitfields, FP16 pairs. Status TRANSLATE; validation Implemented.

M024 Fixed-point financial boundary. Domain Numeric/encoding. Use fixed-point/decimal for exact currency-like quantities; unrelated to geometry unless typed. GPU realization: Integer scaled arithmetic. Status RETAIN; validation Established.
UGTS mechanism domain: Topology/control.

M025 One-bit parity narrow role. Domain Topology/control. One bit selects a route, orientation or validity convention; continuous state remains separate. GPU realization: Bitfield predicate. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented.

M026 One-bit support mask. Domain Topology/control. A bit masks candidate sectors; it does not encode full geometry. GPU realization: Bitset/texture/buffer mask. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented.
M027 Deterministic jitter seed. Domain Topology/control. Pseudo-random sequence is keyed by lineage/address for replay. GPU realization: Hash/blue-noise index. Status TRANSLATE; validation Specified.
UGTS mechanism domain: Glyph geometry.

M028 D-to-R cut and unroll. Domain Glyph geometry. A curve segment changes constraint class from loop arc to open segment while upper loop remains. GPU realization: Parametric curve morph or SDF blend. Status RETAIN; validation Constructive.
M029 B-to-R lower-loop unfurl. Domain Glyph geometry. Release one loop edge and map it to an open leg. GPU realization: Grammar rewrite. Status RETAIN; validation Constructive.
M030 Phi loop-plus-stem decomposition. Domain Glyph geometry. Primitive graph with loop node and axial segment. GPU realization: SDF union or vector graph. Status RETAIN; validation Constructive.
UGTS mechanism domain: Kinematics.

M031 Stem as cutting/rotation axis. Domain Kinematics. Axis defines local frame, cut plane and rotational reference. GPU realization: Normalized axis vector in state. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented.

M032 Side-view pyramid as delta triangle. Domain Kinematics. Use a 2D triangular cross-section for a conical/pyramidal support. GPU realization: Cone/triangle SDF. Status TRANSLATE; validation Constructive.

M033 Delta-T changing axis. Domain Kinematics. Store reference axis and time derivative separately. GPU realization: Axis vector plus angular velocity/torque field. Status TRANSLATE; validation Specified.

M034 Loop-to-line release. Domain Kinematics. Topology flag selects closed relation vs open parametric segment. GPU realization: Branchless blend or event-triggered rewrite. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented as route.
M035 Localized parity hinge. Domain Kinematics. A graph edge toggles while a pivot node remains invariant. GPU realization: Adjacency bit plus pivot ID. Status RETAIN; validation Specified.
UGTS mechanism domain: Field geometry.

M036 Global hinge everywhere. Domain Field geometry. A field parameter switches or blends two implicit functions over the domain. GPU realization: `f=(1-p)f_closed+p f_open`. Status TRANSLATE; validation Specified.
M037 Split zero-centered oval. Domain Kinematics. Two half-curves share a zero-displacement boundary. GPU realization: Paired parametric arcs. Status RETAIN; validation Constructive.

M038 Antisymmetric torsional wave. Domain Kinematics. Opposite signed displacement about the central hinge. GPU realization: Sinusoidal phase with sign by side. Status TRANSLATE; validation Physical model dependent.
M039 2π unrolled into two π arches. Domain Kinematics. Partition a periodic path into two half-period intervals. GPU realization: Phase interval test. Status RETAIN; validation Exact.

M040 1:1 arch balance. Domain Kinematics. Equal interval length; amplitude balance is a model parameter, not universal stability law. GPU realization: Normalization constraint. Status BOUNDED; validation Conditional.
UGTS mechanism domain: Overlap geometry.
M041 Lens intersection region. Domain Overlap geometry. Explicit intersection `A∩B` with area/phase/confidence. GPU realization: SDF max/intersection. Status RETAIN; validation Exact geometry.

M042 Constructive interference interpretation. Domain Overlap geometry. Combine complex amplitudes where supports intersect. GPU realization: Complex/phasor add. Status TRANSLATE; validation Model dependent.
M043 Tolerance/phase-slip buffer. Domain Overlap geometry. Overlap width is a measurable alignment or phase-error margin. GPU realization: Guard-band scalar. Status TRANSLATE; validation Measurable.

M044 Mutual-information domain. Domain Overlap geometry. Use overlap membership as a join key; mutual information requires distributions, not area alone. GPU realization: Set intersection plus statistics. Status CORRECTED; validation Conditional.
UGTS mechanism domain: Metric geometry.
M045 Scaled 5–12–13 triangle. Domain Metric geometry. Multiply the Pythagorean triple by 0.3. GPU realization: Test vector/constants. Status RETAIN; validation Exact.
M046 Leg ratio 2.4. Domain Metric geometry. Aspect/torque parameter `q=2.4`. GPU realization: Uniform scalar. Status RETAIN; validation Exact.

M047 Torque-cone angle. Domain Metric geometry. Derive cone half-angle from leg ratio under stated triangle convention. GPU realization: Precomputed cosine in state. Status RETAIN; validation Exact under convention.
M048 Logarithmic spiral step law. Domain Kinematics. Scale changes exponentially with phase. GPU realization: `exp2`/LUT recurrence. Status TRANSLATE; validation Parameter dependent.
UGTS mechanism domain: Coordinate geometry.

M049 Base-2 log-radius. Domain Coordinate geometry. Multiplicative radial scale becomes additive coordinate displacement. GPU realization: Log2 LUT or approximation. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented concept.

M050 Local spherical chart. Domain Coordinate geometry. Use radial-angular coordinates locally around a query/coupler; not a global world replacement. GPU realization: Dot/radius tests or spherical bins. Status RETAIN; validation Canonical.
UGTS mechanism domain: Support geometry.

M051 Cone support. Domain Support geometry. Admit candidates satisfying radial reach and angular cosine threshold. GPU realization: Branchless norm/dot compares. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented.

M052 Nested shell support. Domain Support geometry. Partition radius into ordered intervals for multiscale relevance. GPU realization: Bucket by radius/log radius. Status RETAIN; validation Specified.
UGTS mechanism domain: Routing geometry.

M053 Four-chamber hourglass. Domain Routing geometry. Four routing sectors meet at a central rank-changing locus. GPU realization: Two route bits plus event guard. Status TRANSLATE; validation Canonical abstraction.
M054 Pinch event locus. Domain Routing geometry. A guard surface at which rank, route or mode changes. GPU realization: SDF/measurement threshold. Status RETAIN; validation Measurable.
M055 Invariant eigen-axis. Domain Routing geometry. A tagged axis/mode remains invariant across route transition. GPU realization: Invariant field/tag. Status TRANSLATE; validation Specified.
M056 Swept phase arc. Domain Routing geometry. Phase parameter maps between routing sectors. GPU realization: Phase function and branch map. Status TRANSLATE; validation Specified.

M057 Trident 3-to-1 convergence. Domain Routing geometry. Three input channels merge into one event/reset channel. GPU realization: Reduction tree or fan-in. Status TRANSLATE; validation Constructive.
UGTS mechanism domain: Fluid threshold.

M058 Pythagorean-cup trigger. Domain Fluid threshold. Hysteretic threshold state machine with latch and reset. GPU realization: Guard crossing plus state reset. Status RETAIN; validation Physical principle established; corpus mapping unvalidated.
M059 Greedy reset cycle. Domain Fluid threshold. On trigger, emit event then reset selected accumulator/state. GPU realization: Atomic commit + clear/FIFO. Status TRANSLATE; validation Specified.
M060 Inward G/shelf transform. Domain Glyph geometry. Additional glyph grammar rule; not core topology. GPU realization: Vector/SDF morph. Status OPTIONAL; validation Exploratory.
UGTS mechanism domain: Topology geometry.

M061 Lemniscate crossing. Domain Topology geometry. A crossing with orientation/chirality state and two lobes. GPU realization: Two-sheet parametric curve plus route bit. Status TRANSLATE; validation Exploratory.

M062 Escher-style shrink to crossing. Domain Topology geometry. Use bounded log-scale coordinate; do not infer infinite physical resolution. GPU realization: Clamped log coordinate. Status CORRECTED; validation Bounded.
M063 Cone SDF. Domain Field geometry. Implicit conical support/boundary function. GPU realization: Analytic SDF. Status RETAIN; validation Specified.
M064 Sphere SDF. Domain Field geometry. `f(p)=||p||-R` with zero guard. GPU realization: Native benchmark relation. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented and validated.
UGTS mechanism domain: Topology.

M065 Möbius orientation reversal. Domain Topology. A quotient boundary reverses orientation when traversed. GPU realization: Orientation bit toggled at portal. Status TRANSLATE; validation Mathematically exact abstraction.

M066 Klein gluing map. Domain Topology. Specify ports and an orientation-reversing identification; use as routing, not literal container. GPU realization: Portal table/quotient coordinate transform. Status TRANSLATE; validation Canonical abstraction.

M067 Same coordinate, different sheet. Domain Topology. State includes sheet/phase/address; coordinate equality alone does not imply coupling. GPU realization: Sheet field plus compatibility predicate. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented.
M068 Non-orientable orientation bit. Domain Topology. One bit records local orientation class and toggles at gluing maps. GPU realization: Packed bitfield. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented.

M069 Projected self-intersection. Domain Topology. Treat apparent collision as two distinct sheet/address states unless physical interaction is specified. GPU realization: Sheet-aware collision key. Status CORRECTED; validation Specified.

M070 Double vacuum as incompatibility. Domain Topology. No coupling because compatibility is false, despite co-location. GPU realization: Mask/phase/sheet predicate. Status RETAIN; validation Canonical.
M071 Phase-separated co-location. Domain Topology. Phase is part of state and coupling law. GPU realization: Phase field and tolerance. Status RETAIN; validation Specified.
M072 Four-way routing partition. Domain Topology. Two route bits select one of four sectors around an event locus. GPU realization: Switch/case or LUT. Status TRANSLATE; validation Specified.
M073 Portal/gluing transition. Domain Topology. At event, apply coordinate, sheet, orientation and lineage transform. GPU realization: Transition kernel. Status RETAIN; validation Specified.
M074 Branch transition. Domain Topology. Branch ID is updated only by a declared transition. GPU realization: Event output branch field. Status RETAIN; validation Specified.
UGTS mechanism domain: Identity.

M075 Lineage-based identity. Domain Identity. Identity is seed/generative address plus transition history/invariants. GPU realization: Hash/address fields and append-only event log. Status RETAIN; validation Canonical.

M076 Split/merge lineage. Domain Identity. Splits create child addresses; merges require explicit reconciliation record. GPU realization: Prefix/tree address plus merge event. Status RETAIN; validation Specified; stress test required.

M077 Toroidal/poloidal chart labels. Domain Topology. Use two periodic coordinates where appropriate; no claim of 4D physics follows. GPU realization: Wrapped phase variables. Status TRANSLATE; validation Exploratory.

M078 Re-entry map. Domain Topology. Explicit transition maps output port to input address with optional orientation flip. GPU realization: Portal table/queue feedback. Status TRANSLATE; validation Specified.

M079 Parity-controlled open/closed boundary. Domain Topology. Parity selects one of two topology templates; changes occur at guarded events. GPU realization: Template ID/branchless blend. Status RETAIN; validation Specified.
M080 Sphere eversion analogy. Domain Topology. Useful visualization only; not required by substrate. GPU realization: Optional orientation test. Status DEMOTE; validation Analogy.

M081 Physical Klein self-assembly. Domain Topology. Not supported; requires material mechanics and cannot be inferred from SDF parity. GPU realization: Excluded. Status REJECT; validation Unsupported.

M082 Topology-powered energy recycling. Domain Topology. Topology does not create or preserve usable energy without a loss/drive model. GPU realization: Energy accounting required. Status REJECT; validation Dimensionally unsupported.
UGTS mechanism domain: Information architecture.

M083 Finite grammar. Domain Information architecture. A bounded set of productions generates typed expressions/state. GPU realization: GPU tables or host compiler emits IR. Status RETAIN; validation Canonical.

M084 L-system production. Domain Information architecture. Parametric grammar operator with bounded depth and normalized output. GPU realization: Iterative/stackless expansion or precompiled IR. Status TRANSLATE; validation Depth must be bounded.

M085 Projective-phase state manifold. Domain Information architecture. Typed product state, not a single coordinate array. GPU realization: G64/G32 ABI fields. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented subset.
M086 Typed state tuple. Domain Information architecture. Every field has unit, width and semantic convention. GPU realization: Schema JSON + C/GLSL layout. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented.
UGTS mechanism domain: Event calculus.

M087 Relation surface. Domain Event calculus. An event candidate is a root of an explicit scalar relation. GPU realization: Analytic function or compiled expression. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented sphere relation.
M088 Support predicate. Domain Event calculus. Local domain selects relevant candidates before event solving. GPU realization: Radius/dot comparisons. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented.

M089 Compatibility predicate. Domain Event calculus. Coupling requires phase/sheet/address/mode/policy compatibility. GPU realization: Mask/bitfield comparisons. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented subset.

M090 Earliest valid event. Domain Event calculus. Choose earliest certified root satisfying all gates. GPU realization: Analytic root or bracketed solver; benchmark uses current-state guard. Status RETAIN; validation Prototype subset.
M091 Transition operator. Domain Event calculus. Apply atomic state patch at event and preserve invariants. GPU realization: Commit kernel/event consumer. Status RETAIN; validation Specified.
UGTS mechanism domain: Persistence.

M092 External novelty log. Domain Persistence. Closed dynamics may be rebuilt; unpredictable external changes are appended. GPU realization: Compact E16/E32 records. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented format.
UGTS mechanism domain: Query architecture.

M093 state_at(t). Domain Query architecture. Evaluate closed expression at requested time without replay when possible. GPU realization: Compiled expression kernel. Status RETAIN; validation Restricted families only.

M094 next_event. Domain Query architecture. Support + compatibility + root solve + branch resolution. GPU realization: GPU candidate evaluation and reduction. Status RETAIN; validation Restricted families only.
M095 events_in_cone. Domain Query architecture. Return events whose supports intersect query support. GPU realization: Support kernel + compaction. Status RETAIN; validation Specified.
M096 reachable relation query. Domain Query architecture. Graph/grammar reachability under compatibility. GPU realization: Adjacency/bitset traversal. Status RETAIN; validation Specified.

M097 identity reconstruction. Domain Query architecture. Reconstruct identity without relying on current coordinate. GPU realization: Address hash and event replay. Status RETAIN; validation Specified.
UGTS mechanism domain: Pruning.
M098 Support rejection. Domain Pruning. Local analytic filter precedes expensive relation work. GPU realization: First-stage predicate. Status RETAIN; validation Measured by SRG.

M099 Compatibility rejection. Domain Pruning. Filter supported candidates by typed mode/policy mask. GPU realization: Bitwise mask and sheet/orientation compare. Status RETAIN; validation Measured by CRG.
M100 Finite guard band. Domain Event calculus. Use epsilon band around relation zero to tolerate finite precision/noise. GPU realization: `abs(f)<=epsilon`. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented.

M101 Confidence threshold. Domain Event calculus. Event commits only if confidence/certification exceeds floor. GPU realization: Confidence scalar compare. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented synthetic model.
M102 Hysteresis/debounce. Domain Event calculus. Separate enter/exit thresholds and hold time. GPU realization: Stateful guard. Status RETAIN; validation Specified.
UGTS mechanism domain: Numerics.

M103 Certified/bracketed root solve. Domain Numerics. Return bounded root interval when exact analytic solve is unstable. GPU realization: Interval arithmetic or bisection. Status RETAIN; validation Future implementation.
M104 Tangency and degeneracy handling. Domain Numerics. Classify derivative/rank conditions; avoid false crossing. GPU realization: Derivative/interval tests. Status RETAIN; validation Risk register.
UGTS mechanism domain: Field algebra.

M105 SDF zero as event boundary. Domain Field algebra. Zero is semantic transition surface, not a reason to raymarch indefinitely. GPU realization: Relation evaluation. Status RETAIN; validation Canonical.
M106 CSG union. Domain Field algebra. Implicit union operator. GPU realization: min instruction. Status RETAIN; validation Exact for SDF sign.
M107 CSG intersection. Domain Field algebra. Implicit intersection/operator for overlap lens. GPU realization: max instruction. Status RETAIN; validation Exact for sign.
M108 CSG subtraction. Domain Field algebra. Implicit difference. GPU realization: max/negate. Status RETAIN; validation Exact for sign.

M109 SDF gradient orientation. Domain Field algebra. Gradient provides normal/orientation; finite difference or analytic derivative. GPU realization: Derivative code or sampled neighbors. Status RETAIN; validation Specified.
M110 Parity-conditioned field blend. Domain Field algebra. Discrete state selects or interpolates implicit geometry. GPU realization: select/mix. Status TRANSLATE; validation Specified.
UGTS mechanism domain: Indexing.
M111 Log-polar LUT. Domain Indexing. Index radial-angular parameters by additive log radius and angle. GPU realization: Texture/buffer LUT or direct math. Status RETAIN; validation Specified.

M112 BST-to-flat-table translation. Domain Indexing. Compile tree decisions into breadth-first arrays or direct bit tests; avoid pointer chasing on GPU. GPU realization: Flat SSBO/LUT. Status CORRECTED; validation GPU-specific.
UGTS mechanism domain: Complexity.

M113 Horizon-independent closed expression. Domain Complexity. For fixed expression size, state_at cost need not scale with skipped steps. GPU realization: Direct evaluation. Status BOUNDED; validation Restricted claim.
UGTS mechanism domain: Memory.

M114 Novelty-proportional retention. Domain Memory. Store seed/grammar/invariants and external events, not every frame, when reconstruction is valid. GPU realization: Compact event log. Status BOUNDED; validation Depends on reconstructibility.
M115 Seed+grammar+log rebuild. Domain Persistence. Deterministic replay from versioned seed, grammar and event log. GPU realization: Reference implementation. Status RETAIN; validation Specified.
UGTS mechanism domain: Architecture.

M116 Query-first, no mandatory frame loop. Domain Architecture. Authoritative runtime serves state/event queries; projection is optional. GPU realization: Headless compute API. Status RETAIN; validation Canonical.
M117 Optional projection. Domain Architecture. Render/print/display is a consumer of query results. GPU realization: Separate output shader. Status RETAIN; validation Canonical.

M118 Bounded Compatibility Event. Domain Event calculus. Verified event requires support, compatibility, guard crossing and confidence. GPU realization: Kernel predicate and event record. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented synthetic / specified physical.
M119 Event lineage record. Domain Persistence. Event carries route, state flags, time/confidence and lineage. GPU realization: E32/E16 ABI. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented.
M120 Schema-bound one-bit semantics. Domain Architecture. Every bitfield is versioned and named by schema. GPU realization: JSON schema/C headers. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented.
UGTS mechanism domain: Networking.

M121 Deterministic rollback/replay. Domain Networking. Replay versioned deterministic transitions plus external event log. GPU realization: Hash checks and event ordering. Status TRANSLATE; validation Restricted.
UGTS mechanism domain: Risk.

M122 Algebraic closure. Domain Risk. Composition must remain in a normalized relation family or lose direct-query advantage. GPU realization: IR normalization and limits. Status RETAIN; validation Open risk.
M123 Event/branch explosion. Domain Risk. Bound candidate count, branch depth and event density. GPU realization: Budgets/queues/overflow flags. Status RETAIN; validation Open risk.
UGTS mechanism domain: Governance.
M124 Query authority and policy. Domain Governance. Policy/provenance is part of compatibility, not hidden side logic. GPU realization: Mask/tag input. Status RETAIN; validation Specified.
UGTS mechanism domain: GPU-native.

M125 GLSL-to-SPIR-V compilation. Domain GPU-native. Compile compute kernels to SPIR-V; bundled modules are SPIR-V 1.4. GPU realization: glslang or bootstrap compiler; manifest validates magic, entry, local size and bindings. Status RETAIN; validation Compiled and inspected.

M126 Direct Vulkan compute runtime. Domain GPU-native. Create shader module, compute pipeline, descriptors, buffers and dispatch directly through Vulkan. GPU realization: Native Vulkan C++ host. Status RETAIN; validation Executed.
M127 Descriptor ABI. Domain GPU-native. Set 0 binding 0 state, 1 event, 2 counters/commit. GPU realization: Storage buffers. Status RETAIN; validation Validated.
M128 256-thread workgroup. Domain GPU-native. One invocation evaluates one candidate. GPU realization: Compute dispatch groups ceil(N/256). Status RETAIN; validation Compiled.

M129 G64 authoritative state record. Domain GPU-native. Four 16-byte vectors: position/time, axis/radius, phase/guard, metadata. GPU realization: std430 State64. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented.
M130 E32 full event record. Domain GPU-native. Float-bit scalars plus topology/lineage flags. GPU realization: std430 Event32. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented.
M131 G32 packed state record. Domain GPU-native. Pair FP16 fields and pack topology metadata. GPU realization: unpackHalf2x16. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented and validated.
M132 E16 packed event record. Domain GPU-native. SDF plus packed guard/confidence, flags and lineage hash. GPU realization: uvec4 output. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented and validated.
M133 Evaluate mode. Domain GPU-native. Write per-candidate result without global counters. GPU realization: SPIR-V evaluate modules. Status RETAIN; validation Benchmarked.
M134 Evaluate+commit mode. Domain GPU-native. Add four atomic counters for candidates/support/compatible/verified. GPU realization: SPIR-V commit modules. Status RETAIN; validation Benchmarked.
M135 Device timestamp measurement. Domain GPU-native. Use Vulkan timestamp queries and host fence timing. GPU realization: Query pool, p50/p95/p99. Status RETAIN; validation Benchmarked.
M136 Pipeline cache artifact. Domain GPU-native. Persist vendor/driver-specific cache blob; portability is not assumed. GPU realization: VkPipelineCache. Status RETAIN; validation Reload tested.
M137 SPIR-V module manifest. Domain GPU-native. Hash and inspect version, entry point, local size and descriptors. GPU realization: Custom dependency-free parser. Status RETAIN; validation Validated.

M138 Lineage hash. Domain GPU-native. Compact deterministic lineage checksum; not a unique or cryptographic identity. GPU realization: 32-bit hash. Status RETAIN; validation Validated as checksum; structured-seed collisions measured and bucketed during compact validation.
M139 Dense output path. Domain GPU-native. Simple validation layout; non-events still occupy output. GPU realization: Dense SSBO. Status RETAIN; validation Benchmarked baseline.

M140 Verified-event compaction. Domain GPU-native. Use ballot/prefix scan or atomic append to retain verified events. GPU realization: Per-lane atomic and subgroup/workgroup range-reservation kernels with bounded-capacity overflow guard and optional pre-threshold predicate. Status RETAIN; validation Implemented; dense-capacity, bounded-capacity, deliberate-overflow and pre-threshold paths validated.

M141 Structure-of-arrays option. Domain GPU-native. Split position/support/meta streams when hardware favors field locality. GPU realization: Multiple SSBOs. Status OPTIONAL; validation Not benchmarked.

M142 Memory coalescing contract. Domain GPU-native. G64/G32 use 16-byte-aligned records; fixed-query G24 uses a verified 24-byte scalar-word stride; G20 splits five adjacent hot words from a separate lineage word loaded only by retained lanes. GPU realization: std430 aligned/scalar-word structs and optional split SSBO. Status RETAIN; validation G24/G20 strides disassembled; footprint-shifted L2 boundary and isolated cold-lineage locality gain measured on named device; driver-native append resource statistics are identical; paired texture/SSBO paths share the random-access cliff.

M143 FP16 error contract. Domain GPU-native. G32 requires declared range/tolerance; event guard must exceed quantization uncertainty. GPU realization: Half conversion and validation. Status RETAIN; validation Sample validated.

M144 Cold versus cache-seeded compilation. Domain GPU-native. Report shader-module, cold pipeline and cache-seeded pipeline times separately. GPU realization: CPC/CPH metrics. Status RETAIN; validation Benchmarked.

M145 CPU reference oracle. Domain GPU-native. Scalar implementation checks every dense output and compact-stream completeness plus counters. GPU realization: C++ reference. Status RETAIN; validation Passed.
M146 Deterministic benchmark corpus. Domain GPU-native. Fixed formula yields reproducible support, compatibility and event counts. GPU realization: C++ generator. Status RETAIN; validation Passed.

M147 No Unity/Godot target layer. Domain GPU-native. Engine adapters are intentionally absent; ABI is Vulkan/SPIR-V and physical register/stream definitions. GPU realization: Direct runtime and shader modules. Status RETAIN; validation Package audited.
UGTS mechanism domain: Projection.
M148 Cartesian-to-log-polar mapping. Domain Projection. Transform only in output/sensor stage where radial symmetry helps. GPU realization: Shader math/LUT. Status RETAIN; validation Optional.
M149 One-bit sector activation. Domain Projection. Skip inactive sectors before field evaluation. GPU realization: Bitset fetch. Status RETAIN; validation Optional.

M150 Phasor coverage accumulation. Domain Projection. Deterministic complex amplitude/phase accumulation or multisample coverage. GPU realization: Complex pair accumulation. Status CORRECTED; validation Not quantum simulation.
M151 Subpixel gradient alignment. Domain Projection. Use gradient/normal to orient filter or coverage. GPU realization: Derivative/normal calculation. Status TRANSLATE; validation Optional.

M152 Pulse-density modulation. Domain Projection. Encode scalar magnitude as pulse density over a declared window. GPU realization: PDM/delta-sigma kernel. Status RETAIN; validation Established technique.

M153 Anisotropic delta-sigma. Domain Projection. Shape quantization error by radial/angular sampling density. GPU realization: Error accumulator by sector. Status TRANSLATE; validation Requires measurement.

M154 Chromatic log-radius offset. Domain Projection. A multiplicative radial scale becomes an additive log-radius offset per channel. GPU realization: Per-channel add. Status RETAIN; validation Mathematically exact coordinate identity.

M155 Wavelength-dependent phase. Domain Projection. Model dispersion with per-wavelength phase parameters. GPU realization: Vector lanes/channels. Status TRANSLATE; validation Physical model required.
M156 Seeded stochastic blend. Domain Projection. Use deterministic noise threshold keyed by coordinate/lineage. GPU realization: Hash/blue-noise. Status RETAIN; validation Optional.

M157 Log-polar blue-noise screening. Domain Projection. Warp screening frequency to maintain intended density under coordinate expansion. GPU realization: Threshold texture. Status TRANSLATE; validation Output-specific.
M158 SDF edge lock. Domain Projection. Near zero surface, bias threshold using gradient/coverage. GPU realization: Edge-aware threshold. Status TRANSLATE; validation Output-specific.
M159 Dot-gain compensation. Domain Projection. Calibrate binary threshold to measured process gain. GPU realization: Calibration LUT. Status RETAIN; validation Established output practice.
M160 CMYK angular separation. Domain Projection. Assign independent angular offsets to reduce moiré. GPU realization: Per-plate phase/angle. Status RETAIN; validation Output-specific.
UGTS mechanism domain: Physical hardware.
M161 Liquid overclad. Domain Physical hardware. Liquid changes effective index/coupling over a solid guide. GPU realization: Control ABI only. Status RETAIN; validation Prototype class established.

M162 Liquid-core guide. Domain Physical hardware. Higher interaction with harder loss/packaging constraints. GPU realization: Control ABI only. Status OPTIONAL; validation Component class established.
